name: Quadratic-Residue Tournament Classes
definition: For a prime $p\equiv3\pmod4$, let $G_p$ be the tournament on $\mathbb F_p$ with an arc $a\to b$ exactly when $a-b$ is a nonzero quadratic residue modulo $p$.  The **Quadratic-Residue Tournament Class** is $\mathcal Q_p=\{C_a:a\in\mathbb F_p\}$ on domain $\mathbb F_p$, where $C_a=\{b\in\mathbb F_p:a\to b\}$.
comments: This explicit family realizes a logarithmically growing recursive teaching dimension while retaining no-clashing teaching dimension one.
